name: Adobe Firefly — Azure Blob Presigned Storage
description: Registers an Azure Blob Storage presigner for the adobe-firefly-core storage seam: mints read SAS URLs for Firefly inputs and create/write SAS URLs for outputs (storage: "external"). Signs with an account key, or a managed-identity user-delegation key when no key is set. Mutually exclusive with the S3/GCS presigners. Install @azure/storage-blob + @azure/identity.
checklist: Install the Azure SDKs (the only channel — manifests have no deps field): npm install @azure/storage-blob @azure/identity
Set ADOBE_AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT (the storage account name) and ADOBE_AZURE_CONTAINER
Account-key signing: set ADOBE_AZURE_STORAGE_KEY (a storage account access key) — signs the SAS locally; simplest for non-Azure hosts

Managed-identity signing (recommended on Azure): leave ADOBE_AZURE_STORAGE_KEY unset — the adapter falls back to DefaultAzureCredential and mints a USER-DELEGATION SAS. Grant the identity the Storage Blob Delegator role (which grants Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/generateUserDelegationKey/action, required to mint the delegation key) plus Storage Blob Data Contributor for the blob read/write the SAS performs
Import the registration once at startup, before any Firefly service call: import './infrastructure/adobe/storage/azure-register'
Pass blob names (not full URLs) as input/output refs — the adapter mints a read SAS for inputs and a create/write SAS for outputs (an http(s) ref is passed through unchanged)
